- memory_id "1000250": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)

- memory_id "1000186" [constraint]: The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000176": Yuki handed the Team Cinder pager to Diego on 2025-02-21.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
- memory_id "1000162" [preference]: For the Atlas on-call cycle starting 2025-02-19, page Tomasz Nowak instead of Priya for anything.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000129": Team Dune owns the reporting service.  (about: Team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000094": Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
